ORRIN SUPPLY CO. v. TAMBERLY FREIGHT, INC.
908 F.4th 101
United States Court of Appeals, Fourth Circuit.
Opinion
GARVEY, Circuit Judge:
The question is whether the arbitration clause survived termination of the agreement. We hold that it did. The judgment is affirmed.
MOLINA, Circuit Judge, concurring in the judgment:
The arbitration clause expired with the agreement and cannot be revived by implication.
